connector.name: FlashBank
connector.registryDescription: Fixed-fee P2P term loans (no oracles) and flash loans on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Sepolia.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rotwang9000 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: FLASHBANK_MCP_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional EVM private key enabling write tools (create/take/repay offers, faucet). Omit for read-only mode. Use a throwaway key.

env.name: FLASHBANK_MCP_ALLOW_MAINNET
env.description: Set to 'true' to allow write tools on mainnets (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum). Defaults to Sepolia-only writes.

env.name: FLASHBANK_MCP_RPC_SEPOLIA
env.description: Optional custom RPC URL override for Sepolia (similarly FLASHBANK_MCP_RPC_ETHEREUM / _BASE / _ARBITRUM).
